Why this matters for SSC

"Temple X is in Y state" or "associated with Z deity" — 1–2 marks, every year. Master the 12 Jyotirlingas, 4 Dhams, 5 Prayags, and 4 Mathas (Vishnu's 4 monasteries).

---

Key concepts

  • 12 Jyotirlingas (Shiva), 18 Shakti Peethas (Devi), 4 Dhams (Vishnu), 4 Mathas (Adi Shankara), 7 Sapta Puri.
  • Char Dham (Himalayan) = Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, Badrinath.
  • Char Dham (Vishnu) = Puri, Dwarka, Badrinath, Rameshwaram.

2024–2025 Updates

  • Ayodhya Ram Mandir (Ram Lalla Temple): Pran Pratishtha (consecration) ceremony was held on 22 January 2024 by PM Modi in the presence of RSS and VHP leaders. The temple is built on the traditional Ram Janmabhoomi site in Ayodhya, UP. For SSC, Ayodhya is one of the 7 Sapta Puri.
  • Ram Mandir rises in a Nagara-style architecture, with the sanctum housing a 51-inch Ram Lalla idol.
  • Ram Navami (2024–25): Ayodhya is expected to host large-scale celebrations.
  • Kashi Vishwanath Dham (Corridor): After Phase 2 opening (2022), further expansion continued in 2024 — connecting Vishwanath temple with the ghats.
  • Mahakaleshwar: Bhasma Aarti booking is now available online (since 2023).
  • Char Dham Yatra (2024): Kedarnath and Badrinath had record footfall in 2024 (~50 lakh combined).
  • Varanasi (Ghats of Varanasi) is on India's UNESCO Tentative List for future inscription as a World Heritage Site.
  • Pandharpur (Vitthal Temple) — one of the most important Varkari pilgrimage sites; Wari procession continues every year.
  • Sabarimala (Kerala) — devotees continue to climb the 18 steps; restrictions remained in 2024–25.
No new temple was elevated to "national pilgrimage" status in 2024–25, but the Ayodhya Ram Mandir is the most-discussed new temple.
SSC 2025 high-yield: Lock in Ayodhya → Ram Mandir → Ram Lalla → Pran Pratishtha 22 Jan 2024. The 12 Jyotirlingas and 4 Dhams remain unchanged.
